title: How many licks does it take to reach the center of a Tootsie Pop?
summary: This was probably my first deep #philosophical debate as a child. Encountering where does truth exist? What is fake news? What is privilege? All in there for my 3-5 year old mind to wrestle.
author: Greg McVerry
